works.title: On God and Christ
works.subtitle: The Five Theological Orations and Two Letters to Cledonius
works.author: Gregory of Nazianzus
works.blurb: The orations that earned Gregory the title 'the Theologian' — the dogmatic backbone of the Cappadocian doctrine of the Trinity and the two natures of Christ. Williams and Wickham translation.

works.title: Festal Orations
works.subtitle: Popular Patristics Series, Vol. 36
works.author: Gregory of Nazianzus
works.blurb: The homilies appointed for Nativity, Theophany, Pascha, and Pentecost — poetic, dense, and woven directly into Byzantine hymnography. Nonna Verna Harrison's translation.

works.title: Gregory of Nazianzus on the Trinity and the Knowledge of God
works.subtitle: In Your Light We Shall See Light · Oxford Studies in Historical Theology
works.author: Christopher A. Beeley
works.blurb: Beeley's comprehensive study of the Theologian's doctrine of the Trinity and the soul's apophatic ascent to its knowledge — the patristic depth on which the later essence-energies distinction depends, read in its native habitat.
